subject: Possible to change values of parameters in obj after construction?

messages.author: 02e03030784aa6a7
messages.subject: Possible to change values of parameters in obj after construction?
parts:
Hi,

Situation:

obj <- MakeADFun(...
                 parameters=list(w=rep(0,4)),
                 ......)

Now I want to change the value of "w" without reconstructing "obj" with MakeADFun.
In particular, I want to copy over the value of "w" from another object called "o1"


I have attempted the following:

attr(obj$env$parameters$w,"shape") =  o1$env$last.par.best[which(names(o1$env$last.par.best)=="w")]

which seems to work, but my program crashes when I later run a report() which I expect is caused 
by my manimpulation of obj.

Question: is this manipulation of "obj" safe, and is there another better way of achieving the same?


Thanks in advance, Hans

messages.author: 805125e60bf7c9cf
messages.subject: Re: Possible to change values of parameters in obj after construction?
parts:
Hi Hans,
You can feed new parameters directly into report(), so I think you would just call report(w). I think this might be what you were asking. I had the same question last year and Cole Monahan told me about this "trick". I guess the empty parentheses in report() are just saying to produce the report for last.par.best or something. Hope this helps. 

Best,
Mark
